matrix: Auto-Enrollment V1 transport compatibility matrix (WO-2; contract P-3; AC-9). Implementer record, NOT canonical.
rule: VERDICT is MIGRATED only when every regression of the row passed through the Node API AND through the SQL front doors directly (qa/factory/v1/compat_regressions.mjs), each regression porting the certified assertion it names (file:line at 69df2f52). Otherwise PENDING. Computed by qa/factory/v1/transport_compatibility_contract.mjs, never written by hand.

rows.old_db_primitive: insert into factory.nodes (node_id, capabilities, security_role, platform, agent_version, last_heartbeat_at) ... on conflict (node_id) do update
rows.old_authority_check: none: the shared factory_runner login; node_id and security_role come from the caller
rows.old_lease_fencing_rule: stamp:false writes the epoch (never beaten) until a claim cycle completes; onlyIfAbsent writes nothing over an existing record

writes: nodes (runtime_version, runtime_digest, release_id, reported_*, runtime_phase = RECOVERING; never last_heartbeat_at)

rows.new_authority_check: session -> credential under a SHARE lock inside the call's transaction (S-3); identity, tenant and envelope from the credential; ALIVE only on a certified release; a body naming identity is refused

rows.old_db_primitive: update factory.nodes set last_heartbeat_at (when stamping), security_role, capabilities, agent_version
rows.old_authority_check: none; the worker re-asserts its OWN role every beat (N2 required it)
rows.old_lease_fencing_rule: stamps liveness only when admission did not refuse

writes: agent_runs.lease_expires_at = now() for runs not renewed since RECOVERING began (reconciliation)

rows.new_authority_check: credential SHARE-locked; the body carries no role, capability or envelope (refused by name): INVERTS 69df2f52 N2 as S-4 requires

rows.old_db_primitive: claimInTransaction (claim.mjs:140): pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('factory.claim')) -> reaper -> read own role/caps -> pick FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED -> assurance gate -> insert agent_runs -> authoring_run_id = run_id -> insert surface_locks -> work_orders claimed
rows.old_transaction_boundary: one transaction, serialized plane-wide by the advisory lock; 23505 / 54000 / 55P03 = nothing claimed
rows.old_authority_check: role and capabilities read from factory.nodes (a row the node writes itself); local admission before any SQL
rows.old_lease_fencing_rule: lease from BEGIN; started_at = clock_timestamp() at the insert

writes: agent_runs (insert; principal_id, computer_id, credential_id, run_kind, envelope_version, release stamp)
the reaper: agent_runs / work_orders / surface_locks (both fleets)

rows.new_authority_check: the SAME advisory lock key as the frozen legacy claim; the 12 hard gates in the founder's order from the credential's CURRENT envelope, then ranking; a lock held past the lock timeout -> claim_lock_busy (nothing claimed); only work orders holding factory-enrolled-v1

rows.old_db_primitive: one CTE: update agent_runs (lease, heartbeat) where run_id and node_id and in_progress -> update surface_locks (lease) -> update nodes (heartbeat)
rows.old_lease_fencing_rule: fence: run_id = $1 and node_id = $2 and status = 'in_progress'; false = taken over (LOST)
rows.new_authority_check: credential SHARE-locked; the same fence on the credential's own node id; a refused renewal is audited (lease_lost). An enrolled lock carries lease 'infinity': its lifetime is its run's lease, so renewing the run renews the lock

rows.old_db_primitive: fence read -> insert into checkpoints ... on conflict (checkpoint_id) do nothing -> update agent_runs checkpoint fields
rows.old_lease_fencing_rule: a run that is no longer this node's writes no checkpoint (LeaseLost); the caller's checkpoint id makes a retry write one row

writes: checkpoints (insert on conflict do nothing; principal, computer, release stamp)

rows.new_authority_check: the fence INSIDE the front door, on the locked run row, in the same transaction as the insert

rows.old_db_primitive: one CTE: update agent_runs (fenced) -> delete surface_locks -> update work_orders status
rows.old_lease_fencing_rule: fenced on live ownership: a superseded run returns {superseded:true}; a failed run fails its work order

writes: work_orders (insert: exactly one verification work order)

rows.new_authority_check: credential SHARE-locked; ALWAYS fenced on the credential's node id and the run's live ownership; terminal reason required; no silent substitution; a verification-required work order moves to WAITING_FOR_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION, never done; a resubmitted FAILED tree is refused

rows.old_db_primitive: insert into surface_locks per surface; the PRIMARY KEY is the enforcement
rows.old_lease_fencing_rule: 23505 = the other node won; a repeated surface is one lock

writes: surface_locks (insert; principal_id; lease_expires_at 'infinity' so the frozen legacy pick always sees it live)

rows.new_authority_check: gate 8 reads live locks of BOTH fleets (a legacy lock by its lease; an enrolled lock by its run's lease); the primary key still enforces

rows.old_db_primitive: delete at completion; delete expired at claim; lease_expires_at = now() at abort / orphan give-back
rows.old_lease_fencing_rule: locks die with their run's lease

writes: surface_locks (delete at completion and certification; the reaper deletes lapsed legacy locks and enrolled locks whose run is not live)

rows.new_authority_check: credential SHARE-locked; give-back only of this node's own runs

rows.old_db_primitive: update agent_runs set status = 'queued', lease_expires_at = null, attempt_count + 1 (node kept) where the lease lapsed -> work_orders claimed -> queued -> delete expired locks
rows.old_lease_fencing_rule: only a REAL lease expiry makes work claimable again; the stale owner is fenced by renew / checkpoint / complete

writes: agent_runs / work_orders / surface_locks (the same statements, both fleets)
work_orders.verification_state (a lapsed verification claim returns to WAITING)
agent_runs.resumed_from_checkpoint_id (the checkpoint handed to the new owner)

rows.new_authority_check: as claim; the new owner must pass every gate; the reaper's effects commit with the call (work still becomes claimable only after a real expiry)

rows.old_db_primitive: inside the claim: the role-rank filter on requires_security_role and the model-assurance gate; the verify work order points at its run through handoff JSON
rows.new_authority_check: gate 5 (verifier in the CURRENT envelope) and gate 7 (the S-13 floor against the whole authoring set; the campaign's physical separation). The 69df2f52 model-assurance decline is not one of contract P-6's twelve gates; the enrolled runtime keeps it as its own local veto (it does not ask for verifier work its model may not serve)

rows.old_db_primitive: update agent_runs set verification_run_id, verification_node_id where run_id ...; CHECKs verification_is_independent / verification_node_is_independent
rows.old_authority_check: not fenced to the caller; any verificationRunId accepted
rows.old_lease_fencing_rule: only a done run is verifiable

writes: work_orders (the verification work order done; the certified work order COMPLETE or VERIFICATION_FAILED -> queued)

rows.new_authority_check: fenced on the certifier's own verification run; the S-13 floor in the front door whatever the policy rows say; exact provenance of the CURRENT candidate; verifier authority in the CURRENT envelope; the policies can only add

rows.old_db_primitive: update agent_runs set lease_expires_at = now() where run_id and node_id and in_progress; the same on surface_locks
rows.old_lease_fencing_rule: an aborted run is recoverable at once
rows.new_authority_check: credential SHARE-locked; only this node's runs

rows.old_db_primitive: one CTE: runs of this node in progress with a live lease not held by this process -> lease_expires_at = now(); their locks likewise
rows.old_lease_fencing_rule: gives back claims whose COMMIT reply was lost

writes: agent_runs.lease_expires_at = now() for every run of this node not named in keep_run_ids

rows.new_authority_check: credential SHARE-locked; only this node's runs

rows.old_db_primitive: read the run's status and node after a completion whose reply was lost
rows.old_lease_fencing_rule: a retried completion that landed is recognized

writes: nothing on a retry: the answer says superseded with landed = true

rows.old_db_primitive: read the work order's type, title, handoff, surface, required role; update the run's worktree, branch, base_commit
rows.new_api_endpoint: POST /v1/node/claim (the work order in the answer); POST /v1/node/checkpoint (branch, worktree)

writes: agent_runs.base_commit at the claim; branch / worktree at a checkpoint

rows.new_authority_check: as claim / checkpoint; no separate read (no route outside S-7)

rows.old_db_primitive: pg_stat_ssl, the node's row, schema / role reads, a deliberate DDL probe
rows.new_api_endpoint: GET /v1/time; the answers of register / heartbeat (draining, release_current, revocations, rotate_required); the Admin API's computer view
rows.new_authority_check: the node reads only its own state, through its own calls; liveness is derived, never stored (contract §1)
